title: Saint Patrick's Cathedral, Karachi

terrainReference.basis: Original terrain on the cathedral approach between its southwestern entrance and the separate monument.

mapIdentity.scope: The 13-point named cathedral footprint establishes the west front, long nave and aisles, paired projecting transept wings, and short chancel.

note: The exact Qualla original sets the facade and steeple proportions. The Pakistani embassy documents the 52 by 22 metre overall envelope. Native mapping controls horizontal geometry and the original public DEM controls the forecourt review.
